blocks.title: Evaporation
blocks.text: Evaporation kisi bhi darja hararat par liquid ka khud-ba-khud bukharat (vapour) mein badalna hai.

Jab zyada energy wale molecules liquid chhor jate hain aur kam energy wale peechhe reh jate hain to liquid ka darja hararat girta hai; phir hararat mahol se liquid ki taraf jati hai, aur mahol ka darja hararat bhi girta hai. Isi liye evaporation thandak paida karti hai. Nahane ke baad insan ko thandak mehsoos hoti hai jab hawa mein jism se pani evaporate hota hai: pani ke molecules jism ki energy le jate hain. Mitti ke bartan isi tarah pani thanda rakhte hain: woh masamdar (porous) hain, intermolecular forces par qaboo pane ke liye kaafi kinetic energy wale pani ke molecules masamon se bahar aa kar evaporate hote hain, is ke liye energy liquid se aati hai, to baqi pani ke molecules ki ausat kinetic energy girti hai aur pani thanda hota hai.

blocks.prompt: Ek jaise darja hararat par acetone aur pani ke alag hisse aap ke hathon par dale jate hain; acetone zyada thanda lagta hai. Kashish ki forces ke lihaz se wazahat karein. Zyada darja hararat par evaporation tez kyun hoti hai?
blocks.explanation: Acetone ke molecules pani ke hydrogen-bonded molecules se kamzor forces se bandhe hain, to un mein se zyada ke paas bhaagne ki energy hai aur acetone kahin tez evaporate hota hai, jild se zyada tezi se hararat kheenchta hua. Zyada darja hararat par molecules ka bara hissa satah par kashish ki forces par qaboo pane ki kinetic energy rakhta hai, to har second zyada bhaagte hain.

items: Evaporation kisi bhi darja hararat par liquid ka khud-ba-khud vapour banna hai; sab se tez molecules chale jate hain, baqi ki ausat energy girti hai, to evaporation thanda karti hai (hawa mein geela jism, masamdar mitti ke bartan).
